## Rejected candidates
- Previous Menna.Hassan100 reef: weak underwater clarity.
- Previous Abu Dabbab dugong: long edge below 3,000 px.
- Nabq mangrove 19: overexposed water and weak scene detail.
- Red Sea 21: distracting foreground and soft focus.
- Mangrove RasMohammed: heavy shadows and distant trees.
- Shutterstock/Getty results: no permitted redistribution licence.

Florida, US Virgin Islands and Great Barrier Reef bleaching images are clearly labelled comparison images; they do not document bleaching in either atlas basin.
